#   case-name  selected  priority  form-factor  route  available  api  precedence  hp-surround  sinks-present  expected
# selected: the node WirePlumber chose. spk = the X20 speaker sink
# (alsa_output.pci-0000_64_00.5-platform-amd_sdw.HiFi__Speaker__sink), jack =
# the X20 headphone jack sink; other names are used as given. route uses the
# shorthands of routing-cases.txt (hp, spk, acphp, hdmi). sinks-present: comma
# list of the x20 sinks that are loaded (all = both). Expected "nil" =
# keep WirePlumber's choice.
